items.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
items.summary: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

items.title: 'Danny Tommo' jailed for slashing migrant dinghy
items.summary: Anti-migrant activist Danny Tommo has been sentenced to 15 months in prison after using a knife to slash a boat in the English Channel.

items.title: Calls for consent defence change after Joanne Young rape case
items.summary: Joanne Young's daughter joins her mother in calling for a change to the law on consent.

items.title: Anthropic among big fallers in global stock market rout
items.summary: Shares in Anthropic have fallen by more than 10% at Friday's open on Wall Street, just a day after their record-breaking Nasdaq debut, as part of a global stock market rout.

items.title: Daniel Thomas jailed for 15 months for slashing dinghy
items.summary: A judge called the anti-migrant activist a “publicity seeker” who disrupted the work of rescue crews.

items.title: Two dead after microlight glider crashes
items.summary: The bodies of two men have been recovered after a microlight glider crashed into a Scottish loch.
